title: National Policy on Data and Cloud
summary: A national policy published by the Minister of Communications and Digital Technologies as General Notice 2533 in Government Gazette 50741 on 31 May 2024, after a 2021 draft. It aims to improve government service delivery and grow a data economy through faster digital infrastructure rollout, data privacy and security, open data and interoperability, and a cloud-first approach. It seeks clarity on cross-border data transfers and data sovereignty, and applies to government, state entities, the private sector and data custodians. It is adjacent to AI: the 2026 draft AI policy relied on it for cross-border data flows in AI processing.

sources.title: National Policy on Data and Cloud 2024, General Notice 2533 of 2024, Government Gazette 50741
